end.summary:
Discussed locating 2/5 between 0 and 1 on a number line.
Riya described dividing 0 to 1 into five equal parts and identifying the second mark.
Briefly discussed triangle sides and corners using a picture.
The activity shifted back to the number line, and the geometry mix-up was not corrected later in the lesson.
end.parentNote: Asha practised placing 2/5 by dividing the interval from 0 to 1 into five equal parts and counting to the second mark. Riya connected triangle sides and corners to a drawing, and also noticed that a flat triangle is different from a 3D shape. They mixed up the geometry picture request with the number-line activity, and this was not corrected later. At home, draw a line from 0 to 1, divide it into five equal parts, and ask Riya to mark 1/5, 2/5, and 4/5.
